subject.title: Codex app-server stalls after inter-session sessions_send timeout

question: What supported sessions_send timeout contract should apply when the target Codex run has accepted work but the caller wait window expires?
rationale: Current main preserves delayed A2A delivery, the issue asks for cancel/detach/release behavior, and the open compensation PR changes caller-visible timeout results, so the durable contract needs maintainer intent before automation.

options.title: Accepted/Pending With Deterministic Recovery
options.body: Keep non-terminal timeouts as accepted/pending by default, but add proven recovery so the caller lane releases and the target either continues independently or reaches a terminal state.

options.title: Cancel Target On Caller Timeout
options.body: Treat the caller wait timeout as a cancellation boundary and make sessions_send abort the target run, accepting a more breaking timeout contract for existing delayed-delivery callers.

options.title: Inline Late-Reply Compensation Only
options.body: Adopt the focused #68196-style compensation behavior for late replies while leaving broader app-server and diagnostic recovery work tracked separately.

recommendation.title: Accepted/Pending With Deterministic Recovery
recommendation.body: Keep non-terminal timeouts as accepted/pending by default, but add proven recovery so the caller lane releases and the target either continues independently or reaches a terminal state.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent sessions and diagnostic-runtime history makes this the best available owner for choosing the cross-surface timeout contract.
